Neil Smith]]. It is the second volume of the ''[[Star Wars: The Lando Calrissian Adventures]]'' series, following [[Lando Calrissian and the Mindharp of Sharu|''The Mindharp of Sharu'']] and preceding [[Lando Calrissian and the Starcave of ThonBoka|''The Starcave of ThonBoka'']]. It was first published in paperback by [[Del Rey]] on [[September 12]], [[1983]], and the complete series was later compiled in [[The Lando Calrissian Adventures (omnibus)|''The Lando Calrissian Adventures'']] ([[1994]]).
